switcher.label: Switch organization
switcher.heading: Your organizations
switcher.empty: You are not in any organization yet.
switcher.error: Your organizations could not be loaded.

settings.readOnly: Only an owner or an admin can change this.

slug.label: Address
slug.description: Lower-case letters, digits and single hyphens. It is what this organization's pages are addressed by.

details.title: Name and address
details.description: Name and address are all an organization has. Changing the address changes every link into it.
details.personalNote: This is your personal organization. Its address comes from your account and cannot be changed.

create.title: New organization
create.description: You will be its owner. A personal organization already exists for your account and is created with it.

danger.title: Delete this organization
danger.description: The organization is hidden and its address is released. Its members lose access to it.
danger.personalNote: Your personal organization is removed with your account and cannot be deleted on its own.
danger.confirmDescription: Everyone in it loses access and the address becomes available again. This cannot be undone from here.

members.title: Members
members.description: Who belongs to this organization, and as what. A second member arrives by invitation.
members.empty: This organization has no other members yet.
members.error: The members could not be loaded.

remove.title: Remove {{name}}?
remove.description: They lose access to this organization. They can be invited back.

leave.title: Leave {{name}}?
leave.description: You lose access to this organization. Only an invitation can bring you back.

invitations.title: Pending invitations
invitations.description: Invitations waiting to be accepted. Nothing is emailed yet, so the person has to be told another way.
invitations.error: The invitations could not be loaded.

email.label: Email address
email.description: The address of the person to invite. It does not have to have an account yet.

invite.title: Invite somebody
invite.description: They join as soon as they accept, with the role you choose here. An owner can only be made from a member.

revoke.title: Revoke the invitation to {{email}}?
revoke.description: The offer ends. The same address can be invited again afterwards.

inbox.title: Invitations
inbox.description: Organizations that have invited you. Accepting one puts it in your organization switcher.
inbox.empty: Nobody has invited you to an organization.
inbox.error: Your invitations could not be loaded.
